name: Apatzec Intli III
description: The ambitious emperor of the Sun Empire who trusts Huatli and charges her to find the golden city of Orazca.

timeline.summary: At the homecoming ceremony Huatli rides before the crowd, presents the sword to Emperor Apatzec and delivers an oration.
timeline.quote: Huatli turned and presented the Legion of Dusk sword to the crowd below.

timeline.summary: The emperor announces the next stage of expansion to reclaim the south but does not yet name Huatli warrior-poet.
timeline.quote: we are ready to reclaim the south,

timeline.summary: Apatzec privately tells Huatli she will not fight in the south but will guard the eastern coast against a possible Brazen Coalition and Legion attack.
timeline.quote: I am not sending you to fight in the south.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Emperor Apatzec what she saw, and he declares it proof of her worthiness.
timeline.quote: What you saw is proof of your worthiness to hold that mantle.

timeline.summary: The emperor promises Huatli the title of warrior-poet if she finds the Golden City of Orazca, and she vows to retrieve the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The title of warrior-poet is yours if you can locate the Golden City of Orazca.

relations.note: his knight and most trusted tactical advisor
relations.quote: she had become his most trusted tactical advisor.

pages_say.description: The ambitious emperor of the Sun Empire who trusts Huatli and charges her to find the golden city of Orazca.
